confidence.scope: Pointwise within each fixed split for the all-two-test-sounds-correct run indicator only; no simultaneous coverage, no interval for mean accuracy, NLL, or interventions.

executed_config.initialization: Each (seed, split) creates a fresh model and zero Adam states; the same seed gives identical initial weights across splits. Record initial parameter SHA256 before training.
executed_config.intervention_evaluation: Sound after says using input positions 0..5; speaker flip recalculates true sound and full patched document. All six patched test documents for either intervention belong to their corresponding training split. Baselines predict sound only; no full-token NLL comparison.
limits: All interventions return to training combinations in all six test documents; intervention accuracy alone cannot identify a learned mechanism.
No natural-language generalization; five seeds and three preselected overlapping splits do not estimate arbitrary split robustness.
predictions: Subject-flip should reverse the predicted sound; other-flip should preserve it if speaker-dependent rule is stable.
Nearest-animal rule fails on two mismatch splits and succeeds on match split; last-word frequency achieves 1/2.
executed_config.probability_change_definition: Delta = p_patch(original_sound) - p_original(original_sound), separately for speaker and distractor flips; store each document prediction.
executed_config.question: Finite eight-document grammar: speaker retrieval or nearest-animal shortcut under fixed combination holdouts?
executed_config.selection_rule: All 15 runs are reported; no tuning on holdouts or rerunning until good. Default task/data/optimizer reuse v0.1.
executed_config.uncertainty_method: Exact equal-tail binomial inversion on all-two-test-sounds-correct indicators across five initializations, conditional on independent identically distributed initialization assumption. No bootstrap.
executed_config.uncertainty_unit: Training initialization within each fixed split; documents, interventions, overlapping splits are not independent replicates.

micro_research.selection: All configured runs included; no test-based tuning/retries.
micro_research.uncertainty_scope: Each interval is conditional on its fixed split and IID initializations; separate intervals are not simultaneous; no bootstrap or IID test-document claim.
